title: Zach Robinson: From the firehouse to city government, I’ve run toward problems. That’s the mindset I’ll bring to the Salt Lake County Council.
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
Zach Robinson: From the firehouse to city government, I’ve run toward problems. That’s the mindset I’ll bring to the Salt Lake County Council.

“I know what it looks like when local government actually shows up for people, because I’ve spent my career doing it,” writes Zach Robinson, who is running for Salt Lake County Council, in an op-ed.

Actual Article Body:
(Francisco Kjolseth | The Salt Lake Tribune) Zach Robinson, running for County Council At-Large A, speaks during the Salt Lake County Democratic Party's convention at Highland High School on Saturday, April 11, 2026.
